[[2007 NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Tournament|2007 NCAA Div I Championship]] | tournaments = y | tournament_list = [[2007 NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Tournament|2007 NCAA Tournament]] }} '''Marreese Speights''' (born August 4, 1987 in [[St. Petersburg, Florida]]) is an [[United States|American]] [[basketball]] player. A former starting [[Center (basketball)|center]] for the [[University of Florida]] men's basketball team, he won the NCAA national championship in 2007. Speights began his career at Florida in 2006, and averaged approximately four points and two rebounds in only six minutes per game as a freshman for the national champion Gators. He played basketball at Admiral Farragut where they retired his jersey number after just one year. He also played basketball at Hargrave Military Academy. Speights ended the 2007-08 season averaging 14.5 points, 8.1 rebounds per game and 1.4 blocks per game. After his sophomore season, he declared himself eligible for the [[2008 NBA Draft]][http://sportsillustrated.cnn.com/2008/basketball/ncaa/wires/04/08/2060.ap.bkc.florida.speights.0160/ Marreese Speights declares for NBA Draft], held on June 27. Speights confirmed with Florida coach [[Billy Donovan]] on June 12, 2008 that he would not be returning to the Gators.[http://sports.espn.go.com/nba/draft2008/news/story?id=3439407 Florida's Speights tells Donovan he's staying in draft] He is projected as a mid- to late first-round pick. ==Notes== {{2007 Florida Gators basketball}} {{BD|1987||Speights, Marreese}} [[Category:People from St. Petersburg, Florida]] [[Category:American basketball players]] [[Category:African American sportspeople]] [[Category:Florida Gators men's basketball players]] [[Category:Power forwards (basketball)]] [[Category:Centers (basketball)]] {{1980s-US-basketball-bio-stub}}
